title: 第1357章 大魏即将落败羽东侯保存骨干力量第1356章 败局已显
slug: 开局六连抽创建万古帝朝
content_zh:
指尖反复抚摸着那枚质地温润、触手却生出一股透丝丝空间之力的“小挪移符箓”，
羽东侯薛霸微垂的眼帘下，闪过一丝晦暗不明的幽光。
这符箓既是淮中平原的这修罗战场中唯一的生路，
也是他身为统帅最后的手段了。
光是这个保命的符箓，它也是建立在无数将士的累累尸骨之上的。
中军大帐外，喊杀声已如决堤的潮水般漫过层层防线，
震得帐顶灰尘簌簌落下，连带着帅案上的令旗都在微微颤抖。
每一次沉闷的撞击声，都像是重锤狠狠砸在他的心口，提醒着羽东侯局势的崩坏。
留给他的时间，真的不多了。
作为大魏皇朝援军的统帅，羽东侯薛霸心里比谁都清楚，
自己手里的底牌已经彻底快要打光了。
前线的每一寸焦土，此刻都在疯狂吞噬着将士们的血肉。
如今的局面糜烂至此，
再谈什么忠君报国或许已是天大的笑话，
他羽东侯薛霸现在唯一要做的，就是拿出一个最完美的撤退方案。
否则，这几十万大军，都要给大魏皇族那帮在深宫享乐的老祖们陪葬。
但他羽东侯薛霸，不想死，更不想为了那虚无的忠义去死。
他是皇帝魏渊的心腹，
他的首要任务，是保全那些真正属于主子的嫡系人马，以及他自己的老底子“羽东军”。
只要人在，哪怕丢了地盘，哪怕背负骂名，

回到大魏京城，他依然是那个权势极大的羽东侯。
想到此处，
羽东侯薛霸眼中闪过一丝狠厉，
猛地转身看向身侧的传令副将，语速极快且冰冷，
带着不容置疑的威压，
“传令！即刻从后军抽调十万精锐，开赴正面先锋军战场，接替已经鏖战一个时辰、疲惫不堪的龙骧卫等三卫！”
副将一愣，瞳孔猛地收缩，
刚想开口询问这是否太过冒险！后军是最后的预备队，一旦投入正面绞肉机，
若是再被击溃，中军将无险可守。
但他话未出口，便被羽东侯薛霸那冰冷的眼神逼了回去。
那眼神里没有一丝温度，只有赤裸裸的杀气。
“传令！”羽东侯薛霸的声音森寒如冰，仿佛手中握着的不是令旗，
而是一把切割腐肉的解剖刀，
“即刻将护卫中军的十万精锐调往后方两翼，填补防线缺口！
至于羽东军……？
让他们立刻撤回中军大营‘休整’。
记住，是死守中军，随时准备……随本帅转移！”
这是一步险棋，更是一步毒棋。
content_en:
His fingertips repeatedly touched the "small moving talisman" with a warm texture and a force that penetrated the space in its tentacles.
Under the slightly drooped eyes of Yu Donghou Xue Ba, a dim light flashed.
Since this talisman is the only way to survive in the Shura battlefield in the Huaizhong Plain,
It was also his last resort as the commander-in-chief.
This life-saving talisman alone was built on the bones of countless soldiers.
Outside the Chinese army's tent, the shouts of killing have flowed through layers of defense lines like a bursting tide.
The shock caused dust to fall from the top of the tent, and even the command flag on the commander's desk trembled slightly.
Every dull impact sounded like a heavy hammer hitting his heart, reminding Marquis Yu Dong of the collapse of the situation.
There really isn't much time left for him.
As the commander-in-chief of the reinforcements of the Wei Dynasty, Yudong Hou Xue Ba knew better than anyone else that
The cards in his hand are almost exhausted.
Every inch of scorched earth on the front line was frantically devouring the flesh and blood of the soldiers.
The current situation has become so rotten,
Talking about being loyal to the emperor and serving the country may already be a big joke.
The only thing he, Yu Donghou Xue Ba, has to do now is to come up with the most perfect retreat plan.
Otherwise, these hundreds of thousands of troops will be buried with the ancestors of the Wei royal family who are enjoying themselves in the deep palace.
But Xue Ba, the Marquis of Yudong, didn’t want to die, let alone die for his vain loyalty.
He was a confidant of Emperor Wei Yuan,
His first priority is to protect those who truly belong to his master's direct lineage, as well as his old base "Yu Dong Army".
As long as people are here, even if they lose their territory or suffer infamy,
Returning to the Wei capital, he was still the extremely powerful Marquis Yu Dong.
Thinking of this,
A trace of fierceness flashed in the eyes of Yudong Hou Xue Ba,
He suddenly turned around and looked at the deputy general beside him, speaking very fast and coldly,
With unquestionable pressure,
"Send the order! Immediately mobilize 100,000 elites from the rear army and march to the frontal vanguard battlefield to replace the exhausted Long Xiangwei and other three guards who have been fighting fiercely for an hour!"
The deputy general was stunned and his pupils shrank suddenly.
I was about to ask if this was too risky! The rear army is the last reserve force. Once put into the frontal meat grinder,
If it is defeated again, the Chinese army will be unable to defend itself.
But before he could say anything, he was forced back by the cold eyes of Yu Donghou Xue Ba.
There was no warmth in those eyes, only naked murderous intent.
"Send the order!" Yu Donghou Xue Ba's voice was as cold as ice, as if he was holding something other than the order flag.
But a scalpel for cutting carrion,
"Immediately transfer the 100,000 elites guarding the Chinese army to the rear wings to fill the gap in the defense line!
As for Yu Dongjun...?
Let them immediately withdraw to the Chinese army camp to "rest and recuperate".
Remember, we are defending the central army, and we are ready at any time... to move with my commander! "
This is a dangerous move, and it is also a poisonous move.
